title: 第6章 分神转世第7章 帝望第8章 星
content_zh:
蓝星，是一个超行星。它的体积是地球的数十倍，换算其地表面积，也有地球的二十倍。
蓝星和地球相仿，有着辽阔的而蔚蓝大海。其上有着三个主大陆，七个次大陆，以及诸多岛屿。
三个主大陆的面积，每个都不下于地球的欧亚大陆。七个次大陆的面积则与澳洲的面积相仿，至于其它岛屿则大小不一。
这些大陆和岛屿之上，都有着一个庞大的国家。而占据主大陆的龙国，雕国，以及熊国，便是蓝星上最强大的国家，并称为三大国。
蓝星的科技水平与走向，其实和地球差不多。但是由于面积和重力等因素，热武器的发展受到了一定层度的限制，而冷兵器的发展不仅没有退出时代潮流，反而更进一步的展开，这或许便是蓝星与地球在科技上最大的分支。
龙国，首都，沐氏大厦
一个五岁大的小正太，穿着一身西装，坐在董事长特别助理办公室的位置上。看着手中的资料，他随手就用手中的红笔在上面书写。有的地方打勾，有的地方画叉，有的稍做修改，但是绝大部分的资料，他都是直接画上一个大大的叉，要求重新审核。
看似玩笑般的景象，周围那些所谓的精英人士们，却无人胆敢小觑。反而紧张兮兮的看着小正太，眼神中抱持着担忧与期待。
“好了！这一些资料照我修改的去做就可以了。”小正太将一叠满是打勾和修改的文件递了出去。清澈的童音从小正太的口中发出，一位二十来岁，身材样貌均为上等的女秘书，便急忙上前将文件接了过去。她看着手中资料的数量，微微的叹了口气。
接着，小正太拿起了桌上另外一叠资料，说道：“这一些资料，拿回去修改。”
一名年近四十的中年男子，闻言便连忙上前将文件接了过去。他看了看文件之后，不禁皱了皱眉头，脸色有些难看。但是他没有说话，转身便将资料交给助手，开始吩咐着。
最后，桌上便剩下最后的一叠资料。看着这一叠资料，在场这些所谓的精英都不禁面如菜色。
已经被小正太修改好，可以直接执行的第一叠资料，只占据了这些资料的十分之一。稍做修改后，就能准备执行的第二叠资料，也只占据了十分之二。剩下来的这十分之七，就不用说了，在场的人心里都很清楚，那就是打掉重来。
这些资料所代表的工作量之大，可以说是难以想像。也难怪这些所谓的精英人士，会各个面色如土。
“好了！搞定收工。接下来有问题都去找我哥吧！我之后应该会有好一段时间不会回来公司了。这段时间就看你们自己的了。”小正太说完，便跳下了高背椅。他举起右手挥了挥，一名年龄跟他差不多，穿着一身女仆装的小萝莉，便怯生生的从旁边走了过来。
“少爷。”小萝莉抓着小正太的衣摆，将身体躲到他的后面，似乎是在寻求依靠。
小正太轻轻的拍了拍小萝莉的肩膀，然后就抓住了她的右手，往门外面走去他笑笑的对她说：“走喽！我们回家去了。”
“嗯......”小萝莉轻声回应了一下，便低着脑袋，一路跟着小正太离开了房间。
等他们离开之后，那名年近四十的中年男子就走了出来。他拿起桌上那一叠“退件”资料，稍微翻了一下。很快，一条条的青筋便从他的头上冒了出来。
他将其中几份资料抽了出来，然后重重的拍在了办公桌上。“碰”的一声巨响，办公室里的这些精英，身体都不禁一个颤抖。

“王重明，你给我出来！这几份资料是哪些王八蛋做的？你知道吗？就是因为这几份资料没做好，所以导致所有的参数的都出了问题。大家累死累活得这么久，就因为这几个王八蛋的原因，全部要推倒重来。你跟我说说，你跟在场的人说说，现在该怎么办？“中年男子开始大声咆啸。
已经离办公室有点距离的小正太，在听到那影影约约的咆啸声后，也是不禁嘴角微微一抽。尽管已经听过了很多次，但是每次听到都不禁感叹着他的肺活量，真不愧是我们沐氏集团的“兽王”。
小正太拉着小萝莉来到楼下时，一辆私家名车便停在了他们面前。副驾驶座下来了一名管家，他对着小正太行了一礼后，便把后车门打开，迎了小正太二人上车。
“云少爷，我们现在是要直接回去吗？”坐在副驾驶座的管家问道。
“嗯！直接回去就好了。婷婷，你应该也饿了吧？”看着小萝莉暗吞口水的样子，小正太便知道了答案。他向管家看了一眼，管家便微微点了点头。
过了些许时间，他们便回到了家中，那是一座占地数万坪的庄园豪宅。要知道，这里可是龙国的首都阿！不过对于沐氏集团来说，毛毛雨而已。
“沐云，那些东西都处理好了？”一名二十七八岁，外貌与小正太略为神似的男子，一看到小正太便直接问道。
小正太，也就是沐云。他点了点头后，便拉着小萝莉往楼上跑去。但是他边跑边对那男子说道：“沐风，我的哥阿！东西我大体都搞定了，接下来的就都靠你了唷！这我们之前都讲好的了，现在我要休假了。”
看着沐云的举动，沐风只能是摇头苦笑。没办法，谁叫沐云只有五岁！他再怎样能干，再怎样有才华，只要他不想做，谁又能逼他呢？
只是想着接下来的日子，他必须自己去面对公司里的事情，就不禁一阵头大。
不是他能力不足，而是沐云的能力太强大了。什么问题不管，反正只要到了沐云手上，一切都不再是问题。他一个人可以抵的上整间公司的所有人，这个评价可是所有知道沐云存在的人所公认的。
到了楼上，一位女仆便推着餐车，来到了沐云的房间。沐云挥了挥手，那位女仆便自动离去，而小萝莉婷婷则是笨拙的将餐车上的东西拿下来。等她摆好餐具之后，双眼便直勾勾的看着沐云。
看着她眼中的期待神色，沐云笑了笑。随手拿起一块面包就往小萝莉婷婷的嘴边递了过去，小萝莉不失所望，一口咬住了那块面包。而小萝莉也不甘示弱，拿起一块小蛋糕就往沐云的嘴边递了过去。
你来我往，很快的就将东西吃完。有些玩累了的小萝莉便开始昏昏欲睡，她和沐云坐在床边，两手紧抓着沐云的衣摆，等她将头缓缓的靠在沐云的背上之后，就开始打起了瞌睡。这画面让沐云一阵摇头，都不知道该怎么说话了。但是满满的笑意却是弥漫在沐云的脸上。
动用神之全知的能力之后，尽管时间很短，但是还是让沐云获得了许多未来的关键资讯。而蓝星便是一个很重要地方，潮汐前的暗涌，便将会从蓝星这边开始蔓延。因此，沐云便毅然决然的分出一滴精血作为分身来到现世。
当然，对于沐云只是单纯想要到现世游玩的问题方面，沐云是绝对不会承认的。
受沐云本身的气运所托，沐云不仅降生于沐氏，被取名为沐云。沐氏集团是家族企业，在龙国可以排进前三十，在蓝星可以排进前百，是不折不扣的大企业。
沐云三岁的时候，便可以动用“真实之眼”的能力。就在那一年，他发现沐氏集团有了一些状况，便果断出手。他直接找到了沐氏集团的当家，他这辈子的老爹：沐卿平。
一个三下五除二，凭借着无尽岁月所积累下来的知识，以及“真实之眼”照见真实破除虚妄的能力，一场原本可能使沐氏集团出现动荡的危机，便被沐云消弭于无形。
正因为那一次的事件，沐云在家里和集团那边的地位，便被无限度的提了上去。

经历多次事件后，沐云的权威性便被建立了起来，这也是他在集团内能压制住那些精英的根本原因。而这样的局面，却正是沐云所要的。
算了算时间，也差不多了吧......沐云心里盘算着。
content_en:
Blue Star is a super planet. Its volume is dozens of times that of the Earth, and its surface area is also twenty times that of the Earth.
Blue Star is similar to the Earth, with a vast and blue sea. There are three main continents, seven subcontinents, and many islands on it.
The area of ​​the three main continents is no less than that of Eurasia on Earth. The seven subcontinents are similar in size to Australia, while other islands vary in size.
There is a huge country on these continents and islands. The Dragon Kingdom, Eagle Kingdom, and Bear Kingdom that occupy the main continent are the most powerful countries on Blue Star, and are known as the three major countries.
Blue Star's technological level and direction are actually similar to those of Earth. However, due to factors such as area and gravity, the development of thermal weapons has been restricted to a certain extent. However, the development of cold weapons has not withdrawn from the trend of the times, but has expanded further. This may be the biggest branch of science and technology between Blue Star and Earth.
Dragon Kingdom, Capital, Mu Mansion
A five-year-old young lady, wearing a suit, sat in the office of the special assistant to the chairman. Looking at the information in his hand, he casually wrote on it with the red pen in his hand. Some places were ticked, some were crossed, and some were slightly modified. But for most of the information, he directly put a big cross on it and asked for re-examination.
It seemed like a joke, but no one dared to look down upon the so-called elites around him. Instead, he looked at Xiaoshota nervously, with worry and expectation in his eyes.
"Okay! Just follow the modifications I made to these documents." Xiao Zhengtai handed over a stack of documents full of ticks and modifications. A clear childish voice came from Xiaozhengtai's mouth, and a female secretary in her twenties with a good figure and appearance hurriedly stepped forward to take the document. She looked at the amount of information in her hand and sighed slightly.
Then, Xiao Zhengtai picked up another pile of information on the table and said: "Take these information back and modify them."
A middle-aged man who was nearly forty years old quickly stepped forward and took the file after hearing this. After looking at the document, he couldn't help but frown, his face looking a little ugly. But he didn't speak. He turned around and handed the information to his assistant and began to give instructions.
Finally, there was the last pile of information left on the table. Looking at this pile of information, the so-called elites present couldn't help but feel embarrassed.
The first stack of data that has been modified by Xiao Zhengtai and can be directly executed only accounts for one-tenth of the data. After slight modifications, the second stack of data that can be prepared for execution only takes up two-tenths. Needless to say, the remaining seven-tenths were clearly understood by everyone present, and that was to start over.
The amount of work represented by these materials can be said to be unimaginable. No wonder these so-called elites have pale faces.
"Okay! Let's call it a day. If you have any questions, go to my brother! I probably won't come back to the company for a while. It's up to you during this time." After finishing speaking, Xiao Shota jumped off the high-backed chair. He raised his right hand and waved, and a little lolita who was about the same age as him and dressed in a maid outfit timidly walked over from the side.
"Master." Little Loli grabbed the hem of Xiao Zhengtai's clothes and hid her body behind him, as if seeking support.
Xiao Zhengtai patted Xiao Loli's shoulder gently, then grabbed her right hand and walked out the door. He smiled and said to her, "Let's go! Let's go home."
"Well..." Little Loli responded softly, then lowered her head and followed Little Shota out of the room.
After they left, the middle-aged man who was nearly forty years old came out. He picked up the pile of "return" information on the table and flipped through it a little. Soon, veins sprouted from his head.He pulled out a few of the documents and slapped them heavily on the desk. There was a loud "touch", and the bodies of these elites in the office couldn't help but tremble.
"Wang Chongming, come out! Which bastards made these documents? Do you know? It's because these documents were not done well that all the parameters went wrong. We have been working so hard for so long, just because of these bastards, and we have to start all over again. Tell me, tell the people present, what should we do now?" The middle-aged man began to roar loudly.
Little Shota, who was already a little far away from the office, couldn't help but twitch the corner of her mouth slightly after hearing the roaring sound of Yingying Yueyue. Although I have heard it many times, every time I hear it I can't help but sigh at his lung capacity. He is truly the "Beast King" of our Mu Group.
When Little Shota took Little Loli downstairs, a private car stopped in front of them. A butler got out of the passenger seat. After saluting Mr. Shota, he opened the rear door and welcomed Mr. Shota and the others into the car.
"Master Yun, should we go back directly now?" the butler sitting in the passenger seat asked.
"Yeah! Just go back. Tingting, you must be hungry too, right?" Seeing the little Loli swallowing her saliva secretly, the little shot knew the answer. He glanced at the butler, who nodded slightly.
After a while, they returned to their home, which was a manor mansion covering an area of ​​tens of thousands of square meters. You know, this is the capital of the Dragon Kingdom! But for Mu Group, it’s just drizzle.
"Mu Yun, have those things been taken care of?" A man in his mid-twenties, who looked slightly similar to the young lady, asked directly as soon as he saw the young lady.
Little Shota, also known as Mu Yun. After he nodded, he pulled the little Loli and ran upstairs. But as he ran, he said to the man: "Mufeng, my brother! I've finished most of the things, and the rest depends on you! We have agreed on this before, and now I want to take a vacation."
Seeing Mu Yun's actions, Mu Feng could only shake his head and smile bitterly. There is no way, Mu Yun is only five years old! No matter how capable or talented he is, as long as he doesn't want to do it, who can force him?
Just thinking about how he would have to face things in the company on his own in the days to come, he couldn't help but feel dizzy.
It's not that he lacks ability, it's that Mu Yun's ability is too powerful. No matter what the problem is, as long as it is in Mu Yun's hands, everything will no longer be a problem. He alone can be as good as everyone in the entire company. This evaluation is recognized by everyone who knows Mu Yun's existence.
When they got upstairs, a maid pushed the dining cart to Mu Yun's room. Mu Yun waved his hand, and the maid left automatically, while the little loli Tingting clumsily took down the things from the dining car. After she set the tableware, she looked directly at Mu Yun.
Seeing the expectant look in her eyes, Mu Yun smiled. He casually picked up a piece of bread and handed it to little Loli Tingting's mouth. Little Loli was not disappointed and bit into the piece of bread. Not to be outdone, the little Loli picked up a piece of cake and handed it to Mu Yun's mouth.
You come and go and finish the food quickly. Some little lolita who were tired from playing began to fall asleep. She and Mu Yun sat on the edge of the bed, holding onto the hem of Mu Yun's clothes with both hands. After she slowly rested her head on Mu Yun's back, she began to doze off. This scene made Mu Yun shake his head and didn't know what to say. But a smile filled Mu Yun's face.
After using God's omniscient ability, although the time was short, Mu Yun still obtained a lot of key information for the future. Blue Star is a very important place, and the undercurrent before the tide will spread from Blue Star. Therefore, Mu Yun resolutely decided toA drop of essence and blood was separated and came to this world as a clone.
Of course, Mu Yun would never admit that Mu Yun simply wanted to play in the real world.
Entrusted by Mu Yun's own luck, Mu Yun was not only born into the Mu family, but was also named Mu Yun. The Mu Group is a family business, ranking among the top 30 in Dragon Country and the top 100 in Blue Star. It is an out-and-out big company.
When Mu Yun was three years old, he was able to use the "eye of truth" ability. In that year, he discovered that the Mu Group was in some trouble, so he took action decisively. He directly found the head of the Mu Group, his lifelong father: Mu Qingping.
Three times five divided by two, relying on the knowledge accumulated over endless years and the ability of the "Eye of Truth" to see the truth and eliminate illusions, a crisis that might have destabilized the Mu Group was eliminated by Mu Yun.
Because of that incident, Mu Yun's status in the family and the group was infinitely improved.
After experiencing many incidents, Mu Yun's authority was established, which was also the fundamental reason why he was able to suppress the elites within the group. But this situation was exactly what Mu Yun wanted.
After calculating the time, it's almost time... Mu Yun thought in his mind.
